transcript: Hello friends, this quirky wooden fish stress relief gift is a hit for anyone who needs a laugh. Great for birthdays, anniversaries, or just as a random fun surprise. Like this video, share it with someone who loves unique gifts, and remix this shorts to show your funny unboxing moment. Thanks a ton.
